name: Nose Piercings
overview: The Scriptures acknowledge nose and ear ornaments as part of personal adornment, as seen in Genesis 24 where earrings and bracelets are given as tokens of identity and covenant. Ezekiel 16 highlights the symbolic use of jewelry, including a jewel on the forehead (Hebrew: nose), signifying beauty and divine blessing. However, Proverbs 11:22 warns against external beauty without discretion, illustrating that adornment should not replace godly character. Isaiah 3:18 also reflects on the Lord’s judgment by removing ornamental pride, reminding believers that true worth is found in holiness rather than outward decoration.
